title: load_resource_pack does not replace/override most file types
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.3.stable, v4.4.stable, and v4.4.1.stable

### System information

Linux Mint 21.3 x86_64 - Godot v4.4.1.stable - OpenGL (Compatibility) - Nvidia RTX 3060 Mobile - Intel i5-10500H

### Issue description

".png", ".mp3", ".ogg", and ".wav" files do not get replaced if you use "ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack()" and set "replace_files" to true. ".dds" files do get replaced successfully though, so what's the difference between how that's loaded and every other resource file is loaded?

It's also good to note that DirAccess does display changes to "res://" after "load_resource_pack()" is used, at least for new files that are brought in. The docs have a note saying it doesn't though.

GDScript files do get successfully replaced only if the text is not tokenized or compressed & tokenized.

The behavior is the same between ".zip" and ".pck" loading.

It'd be good to have this behavior corrected-- or to at least have the docs more clearly outlined if this is intended. This function could help devs with making built-in mod support and not need to rely on external plugins (or for players to not have to rely on external software in general).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Load a resource pack with files that replace the file types that are listed above-- set "replace_files" to true.
2. Switch to the scene with the test assets.
3. Only ".dds" files are visibly replaced.

N/A
